scheme_name: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Meritorious Students Incentive Scheme (Class 12th Passed)
other_conditions: Must have achieved the highest marks in the district in the Class 12 examination
Must have passed Class 12 from a government school in Madhya Pradesh
Must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh
benefits_summary: Cash award of ₹5,000 transferred directly to the student's bank account.
